questions.cardDe: Nordlichter entstehen einer finnischen Legende nach, wenn welches Tier im Schnee Funken aufwirbelt: Rentier, Fuchs oder Bär?
questions.de: Nordlichter entstehen einer finnischen Legende nach, wenn welches Tier im Schnee Funken aufwirbelt?
questions.en: According to a Finnish legend, the northern lights appear when which animal whirls up sparks in the snow?

timeline.labelEn: Earliest datable record of a northern light: a Babylonian cuneiform tablet from 567 BC
timeline.labelDe: Älteste datierbare Aufzeichnung eines Nordlichts: eine babylonische Keilschrifttafel aus dem Jahr 567 v. Chr.

questions.notes: The Finnish word for the aurora, revontulet ('fox fires'), comes from the folk belief that a fire fox (tulikettu) running through Lapland makes them when its tail strikes the snowdrifts or its flanks brush the trees. The legend itself cannot be dated, so the timeline shows the earliest datable aurora record (de.wikipedia Polarlicht).

timeline.labelDe: Die Familie Feuerstein, Hanna-Barberas Steinzeit-Zeichentrickserie, startet auf ABC

timeline.labelEn: Leaders sign the Paris climate agreement in New York on Earth Day
timeline.labelDe: Staats- und Regierungschefs unterzeichnen am Tag der Erde in New York das Pariser Klimaabkommen

questions.notes: Also accepted: global warming (Erderwärmung). The agreement was adopted on 12 December 2015 and signed in New York on 22 April 2016.

questions.cardDe: Welches Museum gibt es in Deutschland nicht: Bananen-Museum, Nummernschild-Museum oder Blasinstrumente-Museum?
questions.de: In welchem Ort in Ostholstein gab es von 1991 bis 2018 das Erste Deutsche Bananenmuseum?
questions.en: In which village in East Holstein was the First German Banana Museum located from 1991 to 2018?

timeline.labelEn: The First German Banana Museum in Sierksdorf, from its founding until a fire destroyed it
timeline.labelDe: Das Erste Deutsche Bananenmuseum in Sierksdorf, von der Gründung bis zu seiner Zerstörung durch einen Brand

questions.notes: The card's 'which museum does NOT exist' format was reworked to the banana museum it names. Founded by Bernhard Stellmacher ('Stelli Banana'), it was the only German museum devoted to the banana and was destroyed by fire in the night to 26 November 2018, so it no longer exists.

questions.de: Wie werden umgangssprachlich bei Menschen die dritten Backenzähne genannt?
questions.en: What are the third molars of humans colloquially called?

timeline.labelEn: Avicenna completes his Canon of Medicine, from which the name 'wisdom tooth' derives
timeline.labelDe: Avicenna vollendet seinen Kanon der Medizin, auf den der Name „Weisheitszahn“ zurückgeht

questions.notes: The name refers to their late eruption, usually in adulthood; it goes back to Avicenna's Canon of Medicine (completed 1025, en.wikipedia The Canon of Medicine), translated into Latin as dentes intellectus.
